gbifID.description: Unique GBIF occurrence identifier assigned to each Synemosyna formica record.

datasetKey.description: Dataset identifier (UUID) shared across all records.

occurrenceID.description: Unique iNaturalist observation URL identifying each Synemosyna formica record.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom classification for the observed organism, always Animalia.

phylum.description: Taxonomic phylum for all observations, always Arthropoda.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the organism, consistently Arachnida.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the record, consistently Araneae (spiders).

family.description: Taxonomic family of the spider, always Salticidae.

genus.description: Genus of the recorded spider, consistently Synemosyna.

species.description: Scientific name of the observed spider species, consistently Synemosyna formica.

infraspecificEpithet.description: No infraspecific epithet data recorded for any occurrence.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the record, always set to species.

scientificName.description: Taxonomic designation of the observed spider species, including author and year of description.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the observed spider species.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Original scientific name authorship is missing for all records.

countryCode.description: Country code indicating the nation where each observation was recorded.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for every observation.

stateProvince.description: U.S. state or district where each Synemosyna formica observation was recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: All records denote presence of the species at the reported location.

individualCount.description: Individual count field is missing for all records.

publishingOrgKey.description: Uniform publishing organization identifier (UUID) for all records.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

decimalLongitude.description: Longitude coordinate in decimal degrees for each observation location.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision data is unavailable for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation values are absent for all occurrence records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy data missing for all records.

depth.description: Depth information is unavailable for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy data unavailable for all records.

eventDate.description: Observation date and time of each record.

day.description: Day of month when the observation was recorded.

month.description: Month of observation (1‑12) recorded as integer.

year.description: Calendar year when the observation was recorded.

taxonKey.description: Taxonomic identifier for Synemosyna formica records, constant across the dataset.

speciesKey.description: Unique taxonomic identifier for Synemosyna formica records.

basisOfRecord.description: Record source type, consistently recorded as human observation.

institutionCode.description: Source institution identifier for the observation, consistently recorded as iNaturalist.

collectionCode.description: Record type set to observations for all entries.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each Synemosyna formica occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: Record identifier field, currently empty for all rows.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded each Synemosyna formica observation.

dateIdentified.description: Identification timestamp of each Synemosyna formica observation recorded in the dataset.

license.description: License type applied to each occurrence record, using standard Creative Commons designations.

rightsHolder.description: Names of individuals or groups owning observation rights for each record.

typeStatus.description: No information provided for type status.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means information is unavailable for all observations.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of the most recent interpretation of the occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media format of the observation, such as still image, video, or audio.

issue.description: Data quality flags indicating coordinate rounding, continent derivation, and missing taxon identifier.

synemosyna_formica.description: Human-observed Synemosyna formica occurrence records (2009‑2026) with taxonomy, coordinates, dates, and observer metadata.

description: Records of Synemosyna formica occurrences from 2009 to 2026, supporting biodiversity monitoring.
